data.text:
Store layer implemented on matchday/tk-uhp (commit 9f896af).

json_store.ts — StatusStore over status.json:
- atomic rewrite: serialize (version pinned as first meta field) -> status.json.tmp -> fsync -> rename(2); readers see previous or next complete object only
- corrupt/missing: corrupt file = error Result, never silent reset; missing file seeds skeleton on update() (boot path); read() of missing file = unavailable-hub error
- concurrent in-process update() calls serialized on a promise chain (flock is host responsibility); throwing mutate caught as denied error, chain survives
- removeStaleTmp: sweeps crashed writer's status.json.tmp (hub-start hook)
- unknown fields tolerated at every level and preserved across updates

jsonl_store.ts — SummaryStore port + log half:
- append = single write(2) at O_APPEND per line, file+parent auto-created
- torn tail (no trailing newline) discarded on read; invalid middle lines skipped; files never rewritten/compacted
- 2KB text truncation on write (truncateLogText, writer duty; reader tolerates longer)
- log lines use docs/02 vocabulary prompt|tool|result|think|message|system, t = UTC string on disk; session_start system line carries attached flag + kind in meta
- tail(n, filter)/tailLog/replayLog narrow before slicing; summaries filter via domain matchesSummary

lib/index.test.ts: node/bun std imports allowed at adapter edge only (docs/01 import matrix) — same edit as tk-wmx for clean merge.

Verification: bun test lib/ = 123 pass (92 pre-existing + 31 new), 0 fail. bunx tsc --noEmit clean. Tests run against mkdtemp dirs, never real ~/.hub. Public surface exactly the port shapes + StoredLogEntry/LogFilter/LogStore/ truncateLogText/removeStaleTmp helpers in adapters only.
